game_label: Open (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, anyone can join; their account is created the first time they log in with a password. When off, only people already on the whitelist (or allowed Steam IDs) can get in.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
recommended_for: Tip: The Indie Stone's B42 multiplayer notes suggest whitelisted servers, so Open off.

game_label: ServerWelcomeMessage (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The message shown in chat right after a player logs in. Use <LINE> for a new line and <RGB:1,0,0> for colour.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, new logins are refused with 'Server is too busy' while the server is dropping network packets.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: MaxPlayers (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: How many players can be on at once. When full, new joiners are refused with 'ServerFull' (or wait in the queue if the login queue is on).
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
recommended_for: Tip: The Indie Stone's B42 notes suggest 20 players or fewer.

game_label: PingLimit (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Players whose ping (in milliseconds) stays above this are kicked. 0 turns it off. Staff with the right permission are never kicked for lag.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a player's account is removed from the whitelist when their character dies, so on a closed (Open off) server they cannot come back without an admin.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: Password (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: A password everyone must type to join. Leave empty for no password. A /reloadoptions applies a new password without a restart.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: MaxAccountsPerUser (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Limits how many different accounts one Steam user can create here. 0 means no limit. Only checked when the server runs in Steam mode.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
verification: Read site found in source; unverified: The game's tooltip says it is ignored with the Host button; no code check for that was found.

game_label: AllowCoop (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a player can bring extra split-screen players on the same PC. When off, only the first player on each PC can join.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: LoginQueueEnabled (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players joining a busy or full server wait in a queue instead of being refused. Staff with priority login skip ahead.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: LoginQueueConnectTimeout (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Seconds a queued player is given to finish connecting when it is their turn, before the next person is let in.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

plain_explanation: When on, usernames may use letters outside basic English (for example Cyrillic). Checked when an account logs in.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DefaultPort (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The main game port players connect to. A -port value on the command line overrides it.
when_it_takes_effect: Only when the server starts.

game_label: UDPPort (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The second game port, used for the direct (non-Steam) network connection. A -udpport value on the command line overrides it.
when_it_takes_effect: Only when the server starts.

game_label: Public (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, the server is listed in the in-game public server browser.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PublicName (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The server name shown in the in-game browser and the Steam browser (up to 64 characters).
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PublicDescription (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The description shown in the in-game public server browser (up to 256 characters).
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SteamScoreboard (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, the player list shows Steam names and avatars.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SteamVAC (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, Steam's VAC anti-cheat is switched on for this server. A -steamvac value on the command line overrides it.
when_it_takes_effect: Only when the server starts.

game_label: UPnP (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, the server asks your router to open its ports automatically at start. If the server hangs at start, set this off.
when_it_takes_effect: Only when the server starts.

game_label: server_browser_announced_ip (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Forces the IP address the server announces to the public list. Only needed when the machine has more than one address.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisplayUserName (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, account names show above players' heads.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: ShowFirstAndLastName (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: UsernameDisguises (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: HideDisguisedUserName (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, disguised players show no name at all instead of the 'disguised' label.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SpawnPoint (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Forces every new character to start at these x,y,z map coordinates. 0,0,0 means use the normal spawn choices.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SpawnItems (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Items every new character starts with, as item types separated by commas, for example Base.Axe,Base.Bag_BigHikingBag.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: NoFire (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, fire is disabled in multiplayer except campfires.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: AllowDestructionBySledgehammer (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SleepAllowed (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players can sleep in beds and cars. When everyone online is asleep, time speeds up.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
recommended_for: Tip: Commonly off on public servers.

game_label: SleepNeeded (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, characters get tired and must sleep. Only works when SleepAllowed is also on.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: KnockedDownAllowed (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: UltraSpeedDoesnotAffectToAnimals (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, animals are not sped up while time runs very fast (for example while everyone sleeps).
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PlayerRespawnWithSelf (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a player who dies can respawn at the spot where they died.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PlayerRespawnWithOther (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a player who dies can respawn next to a split-screen or Remote Play partner on the same PC.

game_label: FastForwardMultiplier (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The most items one container can hold, counting every small item such as each nail. 0 means no limit.

game_label: RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, dead players' bodies are also removed when the sandbox corpse removal timer (HoursForCorpseRemoval) clears bodies.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: TrashDeleteAll (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players get a 'delete all' button on bins.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: MouseOverToSeeDisplayName (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, you only see another player's name when you point your mouse at them.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: HidePlayersBehindYou (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PlayerBumpPlayer (the Host screen shows the key name)

game_label: MapRemotePlayerVisibility (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Which other players appear on the in-game map: 1 nobody, 2 faction and safehouse mates, 3 those plus players you can see, 4 everyone. Staff who can see the world map always see everyone.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: ShowCoordinates (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players see their map coordinates in the lower right corner.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PlayerSafehouse (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players (and admins) can claim a building as their safehouse.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: AdminSafehouse (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, only admins can claim safehouses.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseAllowTrepass (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, people who are not members can walk into a safehouse.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseAllowFire (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, fire can damage safehouses.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseAllowLoot (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, non-members can take items from a safehouse.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseAllowRespawn (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a player who dies can respawn inside a safehouse they belonged to.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: In-game days a character must survive before they can claim a safehouse. 0 means straight away.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafeHouseRemovalTime (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Real-world hours a safehouse can go unvisited before it is removed. 0 turns removal off.

game_label: SafehouseAllowNonResidential (the Host screen shows the key name)

when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafehouseDisableDisguises (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, name disguises do not work inside safehouses.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: MaxSafezoneSize (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The largest area (width times height in tiles) a safezone claim may cover. 0 means no limit.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: War (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, safehouse wars can happen, during which safehouse protection is lifted.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: WarStartDelay (the Host screen shows the key name)

game_label: WarDuration (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: How long a war lasts, in seconds.

game_label: WarSafehouseHitPoints (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The safehouse hit point limit used during wars.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
verification: Read site found in source; unverified: Meaning of the limit not traced.

game_label: DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a safehouse acts like a normal house while an owner is online, so its protection only applies while they are offline.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: Faction (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players can create factions.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: FactionDaySurvivedToCreate (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: In-game days a character must survive before creating a faction.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: FactionPlayersRequiredForTag (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: How many members a faction needs before its owner can set a name tag.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PVP (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players can hurt and kill each other.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PVPLogToolChat (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, PvP events are reported in admin chat.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PVPLogToolFile (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, PvP events are written to the server log files.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: SafetyToggleTimer (the Host screen shows the key name)

game_label: SafetyCooldownTimer (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: How long a player must wait before switching PvP mode again; hitting another player adds to it.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
verification: Read site found in source; unverified: Unit (seconds) not confirmed in code.

plain_explanation: When a player leaves while a PvP timer is still running, their character stays behind for a delay based on this value, so leaving cannot be used to escape a fight.

plain_explanation: When on, a player who has just been hit by another player can swing back straight away.

game_label: PVPMeleeDamageModifier (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Damage multiplier for melee hits between players.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: PVPFirearmDamageModifier (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Damage multiplier for gun hits between players.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
verification: Read site found in source; unverified: How the stored number scales damage not traced.

game_label: GlobalChat (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, the global /all chat channel is available.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: ChatStreams (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: Which chat channels exist, as short codes separated by commas: s say, r radio, a admin, w whisper, y yell, sh safehouse, f faction, all global (only if GlobalChat is on).

game_label: AnnounceDeath (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a message goes to everyone in chat whenever a player dies.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: AnnounceAnimalDeath (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, a message goes to everyone in chat whenever an animal dies.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: VoiceEnable (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, built-in voice chat is available.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: VoiceMinDistance (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The minimum distance in tiles for voice chat.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.
verification: Read site found in source; unverified: How the minimum is used was not traced.

game_label: VoiceMaxDistance (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: The furthest distance in tiles at which voice chat can be heard.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: Voice3D (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, voice chat sounds come from the speaker's direction.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioStaff (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, players with any staff role cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioAdmin (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, admins cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioGM (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, GMs cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioOverseer (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, overseers cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioModerator (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, moderators cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: DisableRadioInvisible (the Host screen shows the key name)
plain_explanation: When on, invisible staff cannot transmit on in-game radios.
when_it_takes_effect: At server start, and straight away after an admin runs /reloadoptions.

game_label: BadWordListFile (the Host screen shows the key name)

game_label: GoodWordListFile (the Host screen shows the key name)
